effects.effect: You and any ally within 10 squares of you can move at full [speed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/speed) while sneaking. Additionally, enemies within 10 squares of you take a [bane](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/bane) on [tests](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test) made to search for you or your allies while any of you are hidden.
